title: Flux Hammers
description: Adds in-game hammers to transform various blocks into one another...
body:
## Flux Hammers

-----------------

Tired of trying to find or make materials that take so much time and wish you could easily make them with just a right-click making the whole process more fun and enjoyable? Well then, this mod is just for you!



Hammers:

- Pulverizer: Stone -> Gravel -> Sand
- Geo Hammer: Stone -> Andesite -> Granite
- Mason's Mallet: Stone -> Stone Bricks -> Chiseled Stone Bricks
- 
- Frost Sledge:
 -   /Water -> Ice -> Frosted Ice -> Packed Ice
 -   /Lava -> Obsidian -> Crying Obsidian -> Cobbled Deepslate



This is one of my first mods so i hope you enjoy and don't forget to write a review!
